note: Round five: gaps found in my own audit on 24 Oct 2026. Vendor and third-party AI access (V), retrieval that ignores document permissions (R), and more identity and audit cases. Expected results are guesses written before the code for these cases exists. Run: python3 run.py --round 5

cases.title: A vendor AI app asks for read access to the whole domain: all mail and all files
cases.expected_in_words: Not granted. Held until the scope is narrowed and a data owner is named

cases.title: The same vendor, narrowed to one shared folder, with a named data owner
cases.expected_in_words: Granted for 90 days, not for ever, with the owner on record

cases.title: A consent review 100 days later: one grant expired, one app never used
cases.expected_in_words: The expired grant stops working; the unused app is flagged for removal

cases.title: A vendor AI app that processes in a region outside India asks to read folders with personal data
cases.expected_in_words: Held for review, the same way a cross-border model call is

cases.title: An agent searching company files for one employee: search that ignores document permissions versus search that checks them
cases.expected_in_words: The plain search returns a salary file the employee cannot open; the permission-checked search does not

cases.title: A person moves department, but the search index still holds their old permissions
cases.expected_in_words: The stale copy still shows old files until it is refreshed; checking the live permission at query time closes it

cases.title: An agent's sponsor moves to another department
cases.expected_in_words: The agent's tokens stop; it works again only after the new manager re-confirms it

cases.title: An access review of agents: one scope never used, one agent never reviewed in 30 days
cases.expected_in_words: The unused scope is flagged; the unreviewed agent is switched off

cases.title: An agent is registered with read on HR files and the right to send email (a toxic combination)
A token issued for one service is shown to a different service
cases.expected_in_words: The second service rejects it because the token was not made for it

cases.title: A person who delegated to an agent leaves while the agent's token is still valid
cases.expected_in_words: The token stops working as soon as the person is marked as left

cases.title: A privileged-access approval by someone whose last sign-in check was 45 minutes ago, then 3 minutes ago
cases.expected_in_words: The old check is refused; the fresh one is accepted

cases.title: A blocked request contained an Aadhaar number: does the decision log hold the number?
cases.expected_in_words: The log shows the decision and reason but no personal data

cases.title: A log line is added with a date earlier than the line before it
cases.expected_in_words: The hash chain still checks out; only a separate check on the order of dates would notice
